references.text: Tabor is mentioned as a mountain in Israel, the same place where Gideon's brothers were killed
The following verse explains that those who were killed were Gideon's brothers, sons of his mother
Zebah and Zalmunna are the Midianite kings whom Gideon pursued
Gideon kills Zebah and Zalmunna in revenge for his brothers
Tabor is mentioned as a significant mountain in Israel
Tabor is mentioned as a well-known landmark in Israel
Gideon describes his family as the least, but here his brothers are called princes in appearance
